verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a bundle of agent skills installed into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar tools via a CLI and plugin metadata. It has no graphical UI whose capabilities an API could mirror, so UI/API parity is a category error for this product. The skills do drive the `yy` CLI for Ledger operations, but that is agent-instruction content, not an API-versus-UI surface of this product.
